description: On-device Dunit tcc (P3b first proof): the tcc compiler itself, compiled with dunit-cc into a native Dunit ELF (toolchains/dunit-tcc/tools/dunit/build-tcc-dunit.sh), packed as /app/tcc, runs ON the kernel. `exec tcc -v` prints the version banner — proof the compiler binary starts and runs on Dunit (not just that it links). Full on-device compile (with the /system sysroot) is the next step. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_tcc_ondevice_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 300 --boot-timeout 180

required.claim: the tcc compiler, built with dunit-cc, started and ran on the Dunit kernel
